title: Debug macros
description:
Use the preprocessor for logging that disappears in release builds.

```
[main.c:14 main] starting with 3 items
[main.c:16 main] total = 60
total 60
```
hints: `MAX(i++, 5)` increments `i` twice when it is the larger value; the inline function does not.
requirements: `#define LOG(...)` that prints the file, line and function (`__FILE__`, `__LINE__`, `__func__`) and then the message, only when `DEBUG` is defined.
A `MAX(a, b)` macro with brackets around everything, and a `static inline` function version; show why the macro evaluates an argument twice.
stretch: Add a log level, so `LOG_WARN` prints in every build and `LOG_DEBUG` only with `DEBUG`.
